# Project Workflow Instructions

Development Order:

1. Backend APIs
2. File processing pipeline
3. RAG indexing
4. Retrieval system
5. LLM integration
6. Frontend integration
7. Testing
8. Optimization

Git Workflow:
- Create feature branches
- Use meaningful commit names
- Keep frontend/backend commits separated

Testing Rules:
- Test CSV uploads
- Test Excel retrieval
- Test PDF retrieval
- Test hallucination prevention

Code Quality:
- Keep functions small
- Avoid duplicated logic
- Add reusable utility functions
